dataset.title: Data for Quantifying Phage-Host Dynamics using Droplet Microfluidics

holdout_eligibility_questions_frozen_bef: Does the dataset preserve independent droplet/biological acquisition identities?
Is there an ordered early measurement series per independent unit rather than only pooled snapshots?
Is there a later fate/outcome variable that can remain hidden until feature and score freeze?
Can early-input channels and later-outcome channels be physically separated without using outcome-derived preprocessing?
Are at least two acquisition fingerprints available for train/calibration versus held-out scoring?
next: Acquire only the smallest manifest/example necessary to determine schema and channel separability. If outcome leakage is encountered before full freeze, mark HOLDOUT_CONTAMINATED_VOID and never score it as prospective evidence.
